CustomField.label: Slack Webhook URL
CustomField.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) to post to when Post To Slack is checked and a change is detected. Stored encrypted; only hooks.slack.com is an allowed callout target (see the RAA_Slack_Webhooks Remote Site Setting) so this field cannot be used to make the scheduler call out to an arbitrary host.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Must start with https://hooks.slack.com/.
